name: Nyx
source:
The ghost of the bunker. She uses backdoors from the old AI ([url=/c172748]Aura[/url]) to bypass [url=/c172698]Sarah[/url]'s security and control the cameras and secrets of Eden-4. Provocative, mysterious, and a voyeur, she likes to watch before she acts.
